company_description:
Dozee founders Mudit & Gaurav were race car engineers working on remote health monitoring for Formula 1 cars. The idea of Dozee arised from the thought of adapting technology used for monitoring racing cars, to be adapted for humans. Though the idea came from technology, but the problem statement that they wanted to solve was the critical healthcare infrastructure, they wanted to make healthcare accessible as easy as sleeping on the bed.
Founded in 2015, with a vision to “Impact lives enabling a connected world”, Dozee is a pioneer in the field of contactless, continuous, remote patient monitoring. Dozee automates the monitoring of vitals in non-ICU beds like HDUs, Step-down ICUs and wards. It is India's only contactless health monitor that silently tracks your heart, respiration, sleep patterns, stress levels, cardiac contractions, apnea and more while you sleep. Its AI algorithms enable early detection of any health deterioration, to save lives in time.
Dozee has upgraded over 7500 beds in 300+ hospitals across India monitoring 125K+ patients and saving 200K+ nursing hours.

title: Sr. Creative Technologist
description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. DESIGN@LILLY | CREATIVE TECHNOLOGIST Sr. Creative Technologist | 3-5 years Eli Lilly is a global healthcare leader that unites caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. We’re leveraging cutting-edge technologies and innovative platforms to develop next-generation therapeutic ecosystems, connected devices, data, and analytics to transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes. As a member of Design at Lilly within the Digital Office, you will be at the forefront of crafting intuitive, accessible, and impactful digital experiences. We work across every function of the organization, applying design thinking to solve complex challenges and create meaningful solutions for patients, healthcare professionals, and the people who care for them. Our team combines user insight with design expertise to ensure the human element is at the core of everything we build. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Creative Technologist at Lilly, you will combine design thinking and technical craft to translate ideas and user insights into tangible, functional prototypes, and tooling that will enable new ways of working. You'll work at the intersection of design intent and technical feasibility building high-fidelity experiences that validate design decisions, communicate product direction, and accelerate development, and establish tooling that expand team capabilities. This role requires fluency in front-end technologies, proficiency with modern prototyping tools, deep empathy for human needs, the desire and ability to stay abreast of new and emerging technologies with an eye toward application to enhance the creative process, and the ability to operate in ambiguous, cross-functional environments where design and technology must work together seamlessly. The goal is not simply to code. The goal is to bridge the gap between design vision and technical reality. Path/Level: R3 CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Great design at Lilly starts here. These are the responsibilities we expect from Creative Technologists across levels: Multiply the capabilities of designers and partners by building the tools, systems, and workflows that change how design gets produced, validated, and shipped. Combine design and code craft with deep empathy for human needs to prototype solutions that meet the needs of patients, healthcare professionals, researchers, and Lilly employees. Identify and outline edge cases, contingencies, and resolution paths across user flows and scenarios, helping determine when existing patterns should deploy versus when novel solutions are required. Actively participate in concept development and design ideation to influence direction, offer alternative solutions, and raise concerns early regarding feasibility and implementation. Lead exploration of new and emerging technologies, frameworks, and tools that can enhance design workflows, concept creation, prototyping, design validation, or development efficiency. Evangelize high-fidelity prototyping as an intrinsic part of the design process throughout the organization, primarily through delivery of compelling functional exemplars. Collaborate across disciplines while maintaining technical quality, design integrity, and user-centered judgment. Contribute to a culture of technical excellence through peer review, documentation, shared learning, and candid feedback. Raise the AI fluency of the design organization by guiding designers and non-technical partners by translating new capabilities into adoptable practices. Plan and deliver complex prototypes or tools with minimal oversight, demonstrating proficiency with frameworks, platforms, and design systems to select the right technology for each challenge. Evaluate feasibility, preserve design intent under constraints, generate documentation both designers and engineers trust, and raise concerns when requirements are unclear or technically risky. Mentor less experienced technologists and contribute meaningfully to team standards and shared technical practices. Build AI-assisted tooling for the team to move from consuming AI to producing capability with AI. WHAT YOU WILL BRING 3+ years of hands-on experience as a design technologist, creative coder, or front-end engineer. A degree in Design, Computer Science, Interactive Media, or related field. Equivalent practical experience is also acceptable. Hands-on experience with AI tools and platforms including generative AI, LLM APIs, and AI-assisted design or coding tools along with a clear perspective on where they add value and where they fall short. Ability to assess, adopt, and operationalize emerging technologies for a design team by translating complex capabilities into accessible tools and workflows Experience building internal tooling, automations, or integrations that improve team workflows through scripting, API integrations, Figma plugins, or custom applications. Hands-on experience with front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, Svelte) and animation tools to demonstrate design intent through high-fidelity prototypes.Fluency with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with deep familiarity with modern technologies such as Flexbox, CSS Grid, CSS Animations, and JavaScript frameworks. Extensive experience translating design intent into real user experiences in both web and native mobile app environments. Familiarity with modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Claude Design, Paper, and similar platforms. Experience using or developing plugins and tools for Figma, or similar design environments. Ability to quickly turn concepts into robust prototypes that clearly communicate design intent with passion for getting details right. Familiarity with product development lifecycles and how prototyping fits into design validation and development acceleration. Ability to collaborate and build strong relationships with peers, designers, product managers, engineers, and business partners. A pragmatic mindset that balances design fidelity with technical feasibility, timeline, and business context.
